messages:
carter: hi team, I'm trying to get access to redwood/observability. I accepted the invite but cloning gives 403 and the repo page shows a SAML prompt. Not sure what I'm missing.

nina: welcome carter! usually 403 + SAML banner = you haven't authorized SSO with the account that accepted the invite. Did you add your work email to the GH account you used?

carter: i accepted with my personal GH account and i did add my work email, but i didn't notice the verification email earlier. clicking the SSO authorize link just refreshes the org page. SSH test shows: ```$ ssh -T git@github.comPermission denied (publickey).```

lee (it): two things to fix: 1) verify your work email on your GH account, 2) enable 2FA. Org policy hides private repos until both are done. I can reissue the invite to your work email if you'd rather keep accounts separate.

onboarding-bot: Please complete steps: add & verify work email, enable 2FA, authorize SSO. See docs: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/gh-access :lock:

carter: ok i verified maya@redwood.ai on my account and set up TOTP 2FA. reloading the org page shows the authorize button now. clicked authorize and it succeeded. Trying ssh again...

carter: ssh now: ```$ ssh -T git@github.comHi carter! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.```

nina: great. @lee (it) can you add Carter to eng-observability with read/write on redwood/observability? carter after that try cloning via SSH.

lee (it): added carter -> eng-observability and granted write on redwood/observability. Also confirmed SSO mapping for the account.

carter: cloning works now, pulled the repo. small question: for local dev should i add my SSH key to github or use a PAT over HTTPS?

nina: SSH keys are standard for dev machines. PATs are more common for automation or when using HTTPS in restricted environments. If you want, add your laptop key and we can help with ssh-agent setup.

carter: added key and pushed a tiny doc change, looks good :thumbsup:

lee (it): thanks for confirming. If anyone else hits a hidden-repo 404/403, check SSO + 2FA first. Closing thread once you say "resolved".

carter: resolved
